polozky.telo: Montreal, Canada, November 3 rd , 2026 – SimActive Inc. announces the use of Correlator3D with Phase One aerial imaging systems to help defense users process tens of thousands of large-format images under tight deadlines. The combined workflow addresses a critical challenge: turning massive volumes of high-resolution aerial imagery into accurate mapping products, faster. Phase One imagery feeds directly into Correlator3D , eliminating separate conversion steps before photogrammetric processing. Users can then automate production and distribute processing across multiple computers to accelerate the generation of elevation models and orthomosaics. polozky.nadpis: GISCorps Seeks Executive Director to Build on Two Decades of Humanitarian Service
polozky.perex: The volunteer-driven geospatial organization is recruiting its first paid executive director as founder Shoreh Elhami prepares for a leadership transition.
polozky.telo: The volunteer-driven geospatial organization is recruiting its first paid executive director as founder Shoreh Elhami prepares for a leadership transition. GISCorps, the humanitarian GIS volunteer program of the Geospatial Professional Network (GPN), is seeking its first paid executive director to help guide the organization into its next chapter. Founded in 2003 by GIS professional Shoreh Elhami, GISCorps connects geospatial expertise with organizations responding to disasters, humanitarian emergencies, and other challenges around the world. Its volunteers have supported projects ranging from earthquake and hurricane response to disease mapping, nonprofit data development, and GIS training.

polozky.perex: By Dr. Mark Bynoe and Sven Cowan When a major storm sweeps across the Caribbean, coastlines can change in an instant.
polozky.telo: By Dr. Mark Bynoe and Sven Cowan When a major storm sweeps across the Caribbean, coastlines can change in an instant. Beaches vanish. Cliffs shear away. Floodwaters push inland into neighborhoods and tourist meccas once considered safe. Climate change poses significant problems in the region. Damaging floods and storms have more than tripled since the early 2000s, resulting in countries suffering yearly losses equal to 17% of their GDP. This is seen as perpetual recession as the region grapples with this constant threat. View of Turneffe Atoll, Belize.
